spoken.purpose: Words said in a call; Caller in Foam, Agent in Cable light.

note.purpose: Italic note under a step name.

small.purpose: Nav links, text links, pill labels, captions.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked names of speakers, steps and statuses; never a kicker.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Fade-in of Turn steps and lines.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Opacity reveals in Turn (lines 1s, steps 1.2s, Planned exit 1.4s).

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Colour and border changes on hover.

motion.name: turn-loop
motion.purpose: One Turn loop; 40s or longer, plays on load, Pause always present; under reduced motion it plays in turn without movement.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: At or below: one column, the ring becomes the rail.

ground.purpose: The body background; the only gradient in the system.

components.name: Primary Pill
components.description: The primary action; one per band.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; background: var(--color-foam, #FFFFFF); color: var(--color-deep-sea, #0B1322); font: 500 0.9375rem/1.45 Schibsted Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-pill:hover { background: var(--color-cable-light, #F5D9A8); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cable-light, #F5D9A8); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Ghost Toggle
components.css: .ds-toggle { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.125rem; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--color-foam-faint, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5)); border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--color-foam-muted, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.72)); font: 400 0.875rem Schibsted Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-toggle:hover { color: var(--color-foam, #FFFFFF); border-color: var(--color-foam-muted, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.72)); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cable-light, #F5D9A8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Secondary action as an underlined link.
components.css: .ds-link { color: var(--color-foam-muted, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.72)); font: 400 0.9375rem Schibsted Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.3em; text-decoration-color: var(--color-foam-faint, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5)); } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--color-foam, #FFFFFF); text-decoration-color: var(--color-cable-light, #F5D9A8); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cable-light, #F5D9A8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Serif wordmark left, muted sans links right.
components.html:
Voice

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1.5rem 2rem; background: var(--color-deep-sea, #0B1322); } .ds-nav nav { display: flex; gap: 1.75rem; } .ds-wordmark { font: 400 1.75rem/1 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--color-foam, #FFFFFF); text-decoration: none; } .ds-navlink { font: 400 0.875rem Schibsted Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-foam-muted, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.72)); text-decoration: none; padding-block: 0.5rem; } .ds-navlink:hover { color: var(--color-foam, #FFFFFF); } .ds-navlink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cable-light, #F5D9A8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Form input on the dark ground.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field span { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.375rem; font: 500 0.875rem Schibsted Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-foam-muted, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.72)); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; background: rgb(11 19 34 / 0.6); border: 1px solid var(--color-foam-faint, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5)); border-radius: 0.5rem; color: var(--color-foam, #FFFFFF); font: 400 1rem Schibsted Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--color-cable-light, #F5D9A8); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--color-foam-muted, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.72)); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-cable-light, #F5D9A8); outline: 2px solid var(--color-cable-light, #F5D9A8); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Status Marks
components.description: Works today, With a Module, Planned: told apart by dot fill.
components.html: Works today With a Module Planned
components.css: .ds-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; margin-right: 1.5rem; font: 500 0.75rem Schibsted Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-mark::before { content: ''; width: 0.625rem; height: 0.625rem; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid currentColor; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-today { color: var(--color-cable-light, #F5D9A8); } .ds-today::before { background: currentColor; } .ds-module { color: var(--color-foam-muted, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.72)); } .ds-module::before { border-color: var(--color-cable-light, #F5D9A8); } .ds-planned { color: var(--color-foam-muted, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.72)); } .ds-planned::before { width: 0.75rem; height: 0.75rem; border: 1.5px dashed var(--color-foam-faint, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5)); }

components.name: Turn Step
components.description: Steps on the Turn track: hollow dot, label and italic note; Planned is dashed.
components.html: <svg class="ds-turn" viewBox="-150 -60 300 120" width="300" height="120"><line x1="-140" y1="0" x2="140" y2="0" class="ds-track"/><line x1="-140" y1="0" x2="20" y2="0" class="ds-fill"/><circle cx="-80" cy="0" r="6" class="ds-dot"/><text x="-80" y="-30" class="ds-name" text-anchor="middle">AGENT</text><text x="-80" y="-14" class="ds-note" text-anchor="middle">Moving a booking</text><circle cx="80" cy="0" r="6" class="ds-dot ds-planned"/><text x="80" y="28" class="ds-name" text-anchor="middle">HUMAN</text><text x="80" y="44" class="ds-note ds-planned-note" text-anchor="middle">Hand-off · Planned</text></svg>
components.css: .ds-turn { background: var(--color-deep-sea, #0B1322); } .ds-track { stroke: var(--color-granite, #3A3F47); stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-fill { stroke: var(--color-cable-light, #F5D9A8); stroke-width: 2.5; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-dot { fill: var(--color-deep-sea, #0B1322); stroke: var(--color-cable-light, #F5D9A8); stroke-width: 2; } .ds-dot.ds-planned { stroke: var(--color-foam-faint, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5)); stroke-dasharray: 2 3; } .ds-name { font: 500 11px Schibsted Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; fill: var(--color-foam-muted, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.72)); } .ds-note { font: italic 400 14px 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; fill: var(--color-cable-light, #F5D9A8); } .ds-planned-note { fill: var(--color-foam-faint, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5)); }

narrative.overview:
Voice is drawn as a precise instrument seen at dusk: a dark sea-blue ground, white type, hairline geometry, and one warm light that marks only what is live. The landing page's Turn ring is the first expression: one call drawn as it happens, time filling a ring, each step the agent takes landing on it as a hollow dot. The system is calm and spare, with large serif words and small tracked sans labels. Depth comes from the ground's tonal falloff, never from cards, shadows or glow.

The brand direction (Nordic minimalism, luxury, reliable, natural conversation) rules out the generic AI startup look (glowing orbs, decorative gradients), call-centre and developer-tool styling, mascots, retro and playful treatments.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ground: Deep sea under a Blue hour radial falloff, fixed to the viewport.
One warm accent, Cable light, reserved for live state and focus.
Serif for what is said and headlined; sans for interface and labels.
Hairlines, ticks and small hollow dots instead of boxes.
Status shown by dot fill: filled is working, hollow is with a Module, dashed is Planned.

rules.name: The Live Light Rule
rules.body: Cable light marks only what is live, active or focused. A line that has finished speaking goes back to Foam; a Planned thing never gets Cable light.

rules.name: The Faint Border Rule
rules.body: A border that bounds a control uses Foam faint, not Granite; Granite is too low-contrast to define an interactive edge.

rules.name: The Said in Serif Rule
rules.body: Words spoken in a call and headings are serif; anything you operate or scan as data is sans.

rules.name: The Label Is Data Rule
rules.body: The uppercase tracked label names a speaker, a step or a status. It never sits above a heading as a kicker or eyebrow.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow or glows. If a thing needs to stand out, it gets Cable light or the Foam pill, not elevation.

dos: **Do** keep Cable light for live state, active steps, the Agent's words and focus (The Live Light Rule).
**Do** separate with 1px Granite hairlines and keep surfaces flat on the Deep sea ground.
**Do** bound controls with Foam faint, not Granite.
**Do** mark unbuilt capability with the dashed Planned treatment.
**Do** give any moving element a visible Pause control, and under reduced motion keep its content changing in turn with no movement.
donts: **Don't** add shadows, glows, cards or photos.
**Don't** use a gradient as decoration; the only gradient is the ground's Blue hour falloff.
**Don't** put the uppercase label above a heading as a kicker or eyebrow.
**Don't** colour a finished or Planned thing in Cable light.
